overview: A romantic, elegant monthsary website that presents a personal love letter, a photo memory album, a song section, and heartfelt memory cards in one polished scrolling page.
features: Floral gold-framed opening with a smooth transition into the letter
A personal love letter displayed as an elegant paper card
A photo album with gold-framed cards, captions, and a lightbox
A music-player section for the couple's song with an animated visualizer
Why I Love Our Story memory cards
A closing message with a petal animation button
All personal content editable from one config section
